# Sporting News

> > Sporting News is a comprehensive sports news and coverage platform delivering real-time scores, analysis, and breaking news across NFL, NBA, MLB, NCAA basketball, and more.

Sporting News provides extensive coverage of professional and college sports with live scores, schedules, team directories, and expert analysis. The site aggregates news from major leagues including the NFL, NBA, MLB, and NCAA, with particular strength in covering the Kansas City Chiefs, player injuries, trade rumors, and March Madness tournament coverage.

## Key Topics

- NFL
- NCAA Basketball
- March Madness
- Kansas City Chiefs
- Patrick Mahomes
- Player Injuries
- Trade Rumors
- Free Agency
- Power Rankings
- Live Scores
- Tournament Brackets
- Coach News
- Draft Analysis
- College Sports
- Sports News Aggregation

## NFL Coverage

- [NFL News, Scores, Schedules & Standings](https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nfl): NFL news, scores, schedules, standings and analysis featuring Mahomes and Chiefs
- [NFL News](https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nfl/news): NFL news articles covering trades, injuries, draft analysis and power rankings
- [NFL Teams Directory](https://www.sportingnews.com/us/nfl/teams): Directory and reference for all 32 NFL teams across AFC and NFC divisions

## College Basketball & March Madness

- [College Basketball News, Scores, Schedules and Videos](https://www.sportingnews.com/us/ncaa-basketball/scores): NCAA college basketball scores, schedules, news and live results hub

## Homepage & General Sports

- [Sporting News - NFL | NBA | MLB | NCAA | Boxing | Soccer | NASCAR](https://www.sportingnews.com/us): Homepage with latest news, scores and coverage across NFL, NBA, MLB, NCAA and more

## Optional

- [140 years of The Sporting News](https://www.sportingnews.com/us/140): Commemorative page celebrating 140-year milestone and sports history moments
